findings: Calendar-aware TimesFM achieved 9.68% WAPE, a 22.9% reduction in error versus weekly seasonal naive. Gradient boosting was essentially tied at 9.69%. Adding promotions and historical transactions did not improve the calendar-only model in this test.
inventory_findings: TimesFM multivariate had the lowest replay cost: 24,305 illustrative units, 20.4% below seasonal naive. Its fill rate was 99.73% versus 98.61%, with 80.5% fewer unmet sales. This is an operational simulation under stated assumptions, not measured retailer savings.
